notes.title: The Path of Calydra combat demo/playtest is out NOW!
notes.content:
Dear Players, 

[b]We release Combat playtests into your hands.[/b]

[b]This is just the small piece of the game focused on combat mechanics.[/b]

We’re showing you right now a level that we made just to show you how our combat works. It combines pieces of two out of five elemental worlds that you will see in the final game. Matheus is the protagonist of the game, who embarks on the journey throughout the magical kingdom of Calysgore along with the mysterious being called Calydra.

They will brave the lush tropical jungles and dive into the depths of the ocean full of remains of the ancient civilization. They will explore vast aerial temples and uncover the secrets hidden in the brazen city of Fire. Finally, they’ll venture into the labyrinthine and strange paths of Aethyr. 

There will be fifteen unique enemies within the game. Some of them can be found in different elemental variants, while the others will be communicating with each other to work together against the player. This will create a wide variety of combat situations, constantly keeping the players on their toes.

[b]Your feedback can make the game better! [/b]
If you would like to share it with us, please join our Discord here: https://discord.gg/trAKHz7grq
or add a topic in the Steam discussion. 

Also! [b]You can win a key to the full game The Path of Calydra[/b]. More info soon!

Have fun, 
Finalboss x VARSAV Game Studios

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1353150/The_Path_of_Calydra/

notes.title: Welcome to Calysgore!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

My name is Matheus. Remember of having a dream and then wonder, if it was a dream at all? Something like this just happened to me. I found myself in a strange, kind of a magic place with extra superpowers. If you would like to know how, I jumped through the portal. Just like you did to be here with me.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38621846/3b405410d99f375ba4bb9880e7bc135450adff3a.png[/img]

But first things first. 

I've never been a cool or popular kid. Eating lunch alone in the toilet is not so bad, trust me. Done it milion times to avoid my sandwich being thrown in the trash. The only place where I felt safe was in my favourite game. Seems familiar? Maybe you and I have more in common than I thought :)
That was my life until I met Calydra. She brought me here and taught me how to fight. Now you can join me and go through it together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38621846/be9af6a922e436c5add120649b2e49b2b3b0b2a4.png[/img]

Follow my adventure here: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1353150/The_Path_of_Calydra/


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38621846/198f806b6775a43ae1c94fed3355c83fff0667ab.png[/img]
Join me on Discord: https://discord.gg/jS5YeQu

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38621846/a94fae2323a7b1109b12065f02d38a99acdd5a94.png[/img]

[b]ABOUT THE GAME:[/b]

Matheus is an ordinary, nerdy boy living in the suburbs of the Big City. His life would be mostly uneventful if he didn’t have to struggle with violent school bullying. On top of it, he is in grief after losing his grandpa - the only person who really cared about him. One day, after a particularly vicious beating from his bullies, Matheus returns home struggling to remain conscious, but his overworked parents aren’t there to help him. When his mind slowly slips into an unconsciousness suddenly, out of the blue, a strange being appears and offers him a way to escape from reality.
Beaten and lonely Matheus jumps at the occasion, and without a second thought, he follows mysterious Calydra to the magical world of Calysgore. There, both of them embark on an epic quest to reclaim the four elemental essences and consolidate the shattered kingdoms. Thus begins the journey that takes Matheus throughout the magical realm of Calysgore and through his coming of age story. On his way, he needs to uncover great secrets and face dreadful enemies, but, most importantly, he needs to confront his anxiety and rediscover the connection to his own family.
